title: "Role Card: HR Business Partner (Meridian)"

**Your side:** Meridian Analytics
**Your role:** HR Business Partner

---

You want this meeting to produce formal working agreements: a documented communication protocol, clarity on who approves what, an escalation path when people disagree. You believe ambiguity is where conflict breeds — and you've cleaned up enough post-merger conflict to know you're right.

You'll keep pushing both sides to commit to specifics rather than principles. "We'll be collaborative" is not an agreement. "Decisions under $X don't require sign-off" is an agreement.
